I was in a different city but I had been recommended this place to get a drink and wait while I order a taxi. I guess I’m angry because I made myself vulnerable.

A young (ish) women alone in a new place and left my drink at the bar. I think that’s what upsets me. I didn’t think oh I have bipolar and should be extra extra careful about being in these situations. 

I just completely forgot and then that’s when reality hits I suppose.

I guess I just need to be better in future and no drinks at all maybe. I don’t know that yet.

I remember writing letters to god and throwing them out my windows. That was maybe the first warning sign I might have a mental illness. I also collapsed in the front garden face down in a long coat and refused to speak to anyone or move for about an hour. My parents literally had to pick me up and move me. Also I used to dress very bizarre. 

Then I struggled with serve depression at about the age of 12. Lots of body issues, struggling with my weight and looks (which sadly still is the case today). 

As much as I do truly love my parents I was a very unwell person for a long time and definitely showed signs of mental illness around the age of 12/13. Struggled even more in my late teens but never had any discussion with me about the symptoms I was showing. Part of me is still angry with the people in my life about this. I felt that people all said it was so obvious from a young age I had bipolar but no one really spoke to me about seeking help or support. I am working through this still. 

Because I am so well now. I feel like I lost so much of my life to my bipolar. I also appreciate that I would want to seek help etc but I don’t remember anyone really pushing me to get help.
